# claude-code-fable-orchestrator

> A Claude Code plugin that runs Fable 5.1 as the orchestrator and cheaper models as workers: five subagents with pinned models (scout=haiku, researcher=sonnet, builder=opus, refuter=opus, debugger=opus), two session modes (Fable = lean orchestrator that never writes deliverables and verifies with one command; Opus/Sonnet = hands-on lead that delegates only searches, research, and bulk edits), a brief template for every agent call, and a /handoff skill that lets a new session resume from a file. Recommended default: an Opus session with a Fable advisor (advisorModel: fable), which Anthropic measured at 3.5 points above Opus alone for slightly less money.

Install: `/plugin marketplace add pithpusher/claude-code-fable-orchestrator` then `/plugin install claude-code-fable-orchestrator@pithpusher`. Copy rules/agents.md to ~/.claude/rules/ and merge settings.snippet.json into ~/.claude/settings.json.

Key facts:
- Model per subagent is set with `model:` in the agent's frontmatter (haiku | sonnet | opus | fable | inherit).
- The global default for subagents is the env var CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL in settings.json.
- Resolution order: Agent tool `model` param > agent frontmatter `model:` > CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL > session model. `availableModels` clamps all four.
- Only the builder agent has the Edit tool; only one builder runs at a time. Parallel agents are used only for read-only work.
- The session reruns the verify command itself after each builder step. The refuter, which reads the real `git diff`, runs only for security, auth, payments, user data, migrations, deletions, changes over ~5 files, or on request.
- A PreToolUse guard hook enforces the orchestrator role only when the session model is Fable.
- Phases pass artifact file paths, not contents, to keep the orchestrator's context small.
- The advisor is consulted about twice per task: after orientation and before substantive work, and before declaring done. Consulted on most turns, it costs more than running Fable outright.
- A subagent cold-starts at about 37k tokens (anthropics/claude-code#74318), so single greps and reads stay inline and same-type dispatches are batched.

Docs:
